capabilities: Keep multiple alternative versions of a word, sentence or paragraph in place and switch between them
Request AI-generated versions, marks and trim suggestions from a chosen provider
Fade passages instead of deleting them and revive or exclude them later
Store cut writing in a per-note side panel and drag it back
Lint notes with editable YAML rules for hedging, wordiness, repetition and passive voice
extras: Desktop only. AI features send note text to the chosen provider and you pay for usage, with per-call costs shown in the Lab; lint rules without AI and all non-AI features work offline. No telemetry or account; API keys are stored in Obsidian's secret storage. The manifest description notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to keep spare phrasings, faded passages, and cut text nearby while writing, or to lint prose for hedging, wordiness and passive voice.

relations.evidence: OpenRouter, Anthropic or OpenAI with your own API key
or a model on your own computer through Ollama or LM Studio

requires.name: OpenRouter, Anthropic or OpenAI API key
Ollama or LM Studio for local models

summary: Writing assistant that keeps alternative versions of words, sentences and paragraphs in place, fades passages, holds cut text, and lints or asks AI for options.
